caseNameFull: Califano, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v. Westcott and Sharp, Commissioner, Department of Public Welfare of Massachusetts v. Westcott

opinions.text: D. C. Mass. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 439 U. S. 1044.] Motion of appellant in No. 78-689 for additional time for oral argument granted, and five additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Appellees in these cases also allotted five additional minutes for oral argument.
